mappings.reason: ADR 0020/0095: retained static process policy, initially false, snapshots subsequent exact Write opens into an exclusive streaming sibling. Flush persists staging; Close/disposal replaces the resolved target. Original Path, physical AbsolutePath/metadata, Unix modes, symlink identity, temporary ownership, independent writers and explicit partial-I/O cancellation/completed-output recovery execute. PCK and native OGV producers cancel invalid output. FileSaveAndSwapTests covers managed failure/child-exit boundaries, 1024 prepared zero-owner/all-thread writes and actual local software Wayland/X11 GPU/Compatibility movie consumers. Foreign hosts, hardware, native allocations and power-loss durability remain unverified.
